summary.content:
Today's selection covers 85 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: How to use the new ChatGPT app integrations, including DoorDash, Spotify, Uber, and others
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Truecaller now lets you hang up on scammers — on behalf of your family
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 8 articles published in the last 24 hours
